name: gmail
title: Gmail
description: Your inbox as rows with the sender, the subject and the snippet; open a message in Gmail, mark it read, search with Gmail's own syntax, browse the labels; an unread count on the bar. One instance per account, each with its own token command; sending only where you turn it on.
author: pal

settings.label: Token command
settings.description: A shell command that prints an access token for the Gmail API: a bare token, or the JSON an OAuth endpoint answers (access_token, expires_in). The command owns the secret; pal keeps the token in memory until it expires and never writes it anywhere. gcloud auth application-default print-access-token, a helper, a broker behind ssh.

settings.label: Address
settings.description: The account's address, for the links into Gmail and the bar tooltip; read from the API when empty.

settings.label: Labels
settings.description: Labels whose unread mail the Inbox palette lists besides the inbox, one per line by name (a filter that skips the inbox, a list you follow).

settings.label: Send and change mail
settings.text: Compose, reply, drafts, archive and star for this account
settings.description: Off (the default) leaves the account read and mark-read only: no compose, no reply, no drafts, no archive, no star, whatever the token could do. Never inherited by another instance.

settings.label: Signature
settings.description: Appended under the body of a message composed or replied here, after a blank line.

settings.label: Bar item
settings.description: When the Unread item is drawn. Always keeps the glyph on the strip with nothing unread, muted and without a badge, so the popover stays a click away.

inbox.title: Inbox ({instance})
inbox.description: The inbox, unread first then recent, with the sender's avatar, the subject, the snippet, the labels, an attachment mark and the date; the pane is the message as text with the quoted replies folded.

keys.title: Mark as read (Mark as unread on a read row)
Reply with the text typed in the bar (send on)

search.title: Search Mail ({instance})
search.description: Gmail's search as you type, its syntax passed through (from:, to:, subject:, has:attachment, newer_than:7d, label:), sectioned by label.

keys.title: Mark as read (Mark as unread on a read row)
Reply with the text typed in the bar (send on)

labels.title: Labels ({instance})
labels.description: Every label of the account, yours and Gmail's; a row opens the label in Gmail or searches it here.

compose.title: Compose ({instance})
compose.description: A new message as a form: to, cc, subject, body; the signature under it. Only with send on for the account.

keys.title: Open the form; on the form, send

drafts.title: Drafts ({instance})
drafts.description: The drafts of the account with the recipient and the subject; open one in Gmail, send it, or discard it. Only with send on for the account.

keys.title: Send the draft, after a confirmation
Discard the draft, after a confirmation

unread.title: Unread
unread.description: The unread count of the inbox as a badge, hidden at zero, the account's title beside the glyph when it has one; the popover lists the newest five as rows — the sender's mark, who wrote it, the subject and its snippet, the time, a star or a paperclip — with a cursor the arrows move and a click sets.

always.title: Nothing unread, kept on the bar (Always)

keys.title: Open the focused message in Gmail
Star the focused message, or take its star off
Open the Inbox palette in pal
Copy a link to the focused message
Move between the rows; a click on a row focuses it

store.tagline: Your inbox in the panel, its count on the bar, per account
features: Inbox: unread first then recent, each row with the sender's avatar (Gravatar, else the initial on a tinted tile), the subject, the snippet, the labels as chips, a paperclip when there is an attachment, the date
Enter opens the message in Gmail at the thread; cmd+Enter marks it read; the pane shows the message as text with the quoted replies folded, the headers and the attachments listed
Search Mail as you type with Gmail's own syntax (from:, subject:, has:attachment, newer_than:7d), the results sectioned by label
Labels: every label, yours and Gmail's; open it in Gmail or search it here
The bar item: the unread count, hidden at zero, refreshed every two minutes and on wake; the popover lists the newest five with Open and Mark as read
Two accounts are two instances, each with its own token command, address, palettes and bar item, told apart by the title and the badge on the tile

Sending is off per account until you turn it on: with it, Compose as a form, a quick Reply typed in the bar on a row (the full form without it), Drafts to send or discard, Archive and Star. A work account stays read and mark-read only
No secret in pal: a command of yours prints the token (gcloud, a helper, a broker), pal keeps it in memory until it expires

actions.title: Open in Gmail
actions.description: The thread in the browser, in the account's own Gmail.

actions.title: Mark as read
actions.description: On an unread row; Mark as unread on a read one.

actions.title: Archive
actions.description: Out of the inbox; send on only.

actions.title: Star
actions.description: Star or unstar; send on only.

actions.title: Reply
actions.description: The text typed in the bar goes to the sender under the Re: subject, the original quoted under it; a form with to, cc, subject and body when picked without it; send on only.

actions.title: Search label
actions.description: On a label row: the search palette with label:<name> typed.

actions.title: Compose
actions.description: The form, then the message from the account.

actions.title: Open Gmail settings
